findings.title: Ingress sends traffic to a port the Service does not have
findings.cause: Ingress web sends traffic to port 8080 of Service web (for shop.example.com/), which has ports http (80), so the controller has no endpoints for it and answers with an error (usually 503)

evidence.command: kubectl get ingress web -n kd-ingress-wrong-port -o jsonpath='{.spec}'
kubectl get service web -n kd-ingress-wrong-port -o jsonpath='{.spec.ports}'

findings.fix: Set the Ingress backend's port to a port the Service exposes (its port number, or its port name), not the container's targetPort.
